**EL-RSP-1.1 Input to bus within 50 ms**

SCCM_Lighting shall put a change of the turn stalk or the hazard warning button on DriverCan0 within 50 ms, in the next TurnStalk or HazardLightButton frame of the 50 ms cycle.

description: Allocated to building block LightingRequestSensing. First segment of the EL-RSP-1 budget. 50 ms is one DriverCan0 cycle, the delay a cyclic restbus frame adds at most.
